_instructions: Copy this file to vault-config.json and fill in YOUR values. NEVER commit vault-config.json to git!
_appsScriptGuide: 1. Go to https://script.google.com 2. Create a new project 3. Paste the code from apps-script/Code.gs 4. Deploy as Web App (Execute as: Me, Access: Anyone) 5. Copy the deployment URL below
_bankAccountsGuide: Add bank account details for each family member. This data NEVER leaves your browser — it's stored only in your local vault-config.json and your browser's localStorage.
_googleDriveStructure: Create these folders in your Google Drive root: People/[Name]/ (with subfolders for Aadhaar, PAN, etc.), Vehicles/[VehicleName]/, Properties/[PropertyName]/, Shared_Documents/
